change.title: pr-80528-flat
change.description: ref(crons): Reorganize incident creation / issue occurrence logic
change.author: Cristian Sotomayor

findings.title: Monitor config copy is computed and then discarded
findings.body: `get_monitor_environment_context` copies `monitor.config` into `config` (line 160) and rewrites `config["schedule_type"]` to the display name (line 162), but the returned dict uses `monitor_environment.monitor.config` (line 168). The display value is never used. The lines were moved verbatim from the base `mark_failed.py`, so this PR does not introduce the behaviour. `tests/sentry/monitors/logic/test_mark_failed.py:111-122` asserts `"schedule_type": 2` (the raw integer) in the event contexts, so the current output is pinned by a test. Either delete the dead lines and keep the integer, or return `config` and update that test expectation. Not a regression in this change.

contracts.action: mark_failed() hands off to try_incident_threshold() after the monitor-environment update and refresh
contracts.equivalent_path: base mark_failed.py `return mark_failed_threshold(failed_checkin, failure_issue_threshold, received)` (removed in this diff)
contracts.before_after: Same arguments and same return value. Only the callee name changed (mark_failed_threshold -> try_incident_threshold). The module moved to logic/incidents.py.
contracts.visible_effect: Same as before: incident and issue-occurrence side effects, and the monitor_environment_failed signal.
contracts.failure_mode: Unchanged. Any exception from the callee propagates to the caller of mark_failed.

contracts.action: try_incident_threshold() sets monitor status to ERROR and get_or_creates the MonitorIncident before any occurrence is produced
contracts.equivalent_path: base mark_failed.py mark_failed_threshold, the same lines (removed in this diff)
contracts.before_after: Identical: save(update_fields=status) then get_or_create, with no transaction added here.
contracts.visible_effect: Monitor environment shows error status and an incident row exists.
contracts.failure_mode: Pre-existing ordering. If create_incident_occurrence raises after the save (incidents.py:95-100), the ERROR status and the incident row stay committed, and the occurrence and monitor_environment_failed signal are skipped. Whether the caller retries or wraps this in a transaction was not read.
contracts.open_question: Do the callers of mark_failed (monitor consumer and clock tasks) wrap it in a transaction or retry on exception? If not, a failed produce leaves the env in ERROR without an occurrence; the next check-in then takes the ERROR branch, which may or may not recover the occurrence.

contracts.action: create_incident_occurrence() produces the occurrence to Kafka via produce_occurrence_to_kafka
contracts.equivalent_path: base mark_failed.py create_issue_platform_occurrence, the same produce_occurrence_to_kafka call (removed in this diff)
contracts.before_after: Identical payload and kwargs. The function was renamed and moved. The imports stay inside the function, so tests that patch sentry.issues.producer.produce_occurrence_to_kafka still intercept the call.
contracts.visible_effect: Issue-platform occurrence for the monitor incident, same as before.

contracts.action: get_monitor_environment_context() builds the monitor context placed in the occurrence event
contracts.before_after: Identical to base. The computed display config is dropped, so the event carries the raw config.
contracts.visible_effect: The event contexts.monitor.config.schedule_type is the integer, as pinned by the test.

contracts.action: try_incident_threshold() loops over the check-ins in the window and calls create_incident_occurrence once per row
contracts.before_after: Identical. One occurrence per row. The loop is bounded by the threshold window, not by the number of rows in the table.
contracts.visible_effect: Several occurrences per incident when failure_issue_threshold > 1, as before.
contracts.failure_mode: Each iteration runs queries (checkin.monitor_environment access, get_last_successful_checkin). The list length is at most failure_issue_threshold, which the validator caps at MAX_THRESHOLD.

contracts.action: SimpleCheckIn TypedDict moves from logic/mark_failed.py to monitors/types.py
contracts.equivalent_path: base mark_failed.py SimpleCheckIn (removed in this diff)
contracts.before_after: Same fields (id, date_added, status). Only the module changed.
contracts.failure_mode: Any importer of sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed.SimpleCheckIn would break. The repository search found none.

summary: This part is a move-refactor: mark_failed_threshold, create_issue_platform_occurrence, the failure-reason helpers and SimpleCheckIn move out of mark_failed.py into incidents.py, incident_occurrence.py and types.py. I compared the removed and added lines and the bodies match apart from the renames, so the behaviour is unchanged. The imports are all used, there are no circular-import risks I could find, and the tests that patch produce_occurrence_to_kafka still work. The only finding is a pre-existing dead variable (`config` in get_monitor_environment_context) that the test suite currently pins; I rate it "consider". One contract stays open: whether the callers of mark_failed roll back or retry when the occurrence produce raises after the ERROR status is saved. I did not read the callers.
